$comment: Provider pack: markitdown privacy-hardened local MCP (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX -> Markdown). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack markitdown (v2 shape: mcp.servers.<name>.disabled:false + permissions array rule). --enable-pack markitdown now also installs the Python launcher (install_local_mcp_launchers via run_pack_merger; the Docker image bakes it via pip install in the Dockerfile). Appends the permissions rule {"action": "markitdown*", "resource": "*", "effect": "allow"} to flip the shipped deny.
